index.boundaries: 141 manually reviewed punctuation-based sentence units. Speaker introductions remain attached. Closing quotation marks, including spaced nested closers, remain with the preceding terminal punctuation. A standalone unit need not contain a matching opening/closing quote; bounded neighboring context retains surrounding dialogue. Not a universal tokenizer.
index.cross_page: Content logical pages correspond to complete source chapters. All four end at sentence boundaries; no split sentence or cross-chapter unit. Future corpora crossing page boundaries require separately frozen ownership/ineligibility. Context never crosses chapter logical page.
index.empty_page: Title-only logical page1 contains genuine source heading, zero selectable sentences and explicit rejection. This is an editorial digital grouping, not a historical blank printed page.
index.abbreviation: Manual review found no abbreviation requiring an internal-full-stop exception in this Ruth subset. No general abbreviation/tokenizer support claimed.
